# html end-to-end: state-only assertions via sngl test --platform=html.

[!chromium] skip 'html tests drive a real Chromium'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output { none { html } }

component main {
    var count = 0
    text(value=string(count))
}

func testInitial(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.count == 0)
}
